task_name: World 140 Task A  -  Wrong-Month Form 8974 R&D Payroll-Tax Credit Diagnosis & July - October Monthly Expense Reconciliation
prompt: Review the QuickBooks Online chart of accounts, Form 8974 / payroll-provider IRC §41(h) R&D payroll-tax credit schedule across July through October 2026, posted July - October 2026 payroll and credit ledger extracts, and period-lock governance facts for Helios BioPhotonics Inc. in helios_biotech_oct2026_rnd_payroll_tax_credits.xlsx. Diagnose why October 2026 6120 Payroll Tax Expenses shows a negative credit balance before adjustment, compute the exact prior-month R&D credit over-applied in October (`JE-2018`), and reconcile audited monthly 6120 Payroll Tax Expenses and 6110 Salaries & Wages across July, August, September, and October 2026.

rubric.description: Diagnoses unadjusted October 2026 6120 Payroll Tax Expenses as -$1,809.26 ($8,111.75 gross TAX-10 less $9,921.01 cumulative Jul-Oct FICA credit in JE-2018-A) and unadjusted October 6110 Salaries & Wages as $45,171.28 ($45,555.90 PAY-10 less $384.62 July credit in JE-2018-B).

Computes the prior-month (July-September 2026) R&D credit over-applied in October as $9,480.82 ($9,096.20 prior-month 6120 FICA credits [$1,858.59 Jul + $3,597.56 Aug + $3,640.05 Sep] + $384.62 July 6110 supplemental credit), leaving only $824.81 earned in October 2026.
Reconciles audited July 2026 6120 Payroll Tax Expenses to $3,217.58 ($5,076.17 less $1,858.59) and audited July 6110 Salaries & Wages to $43,615.38 ($44,000.00 less $384.62).
Reconciles audited August 2026 and September 2026 6120 Payroll Tax Expenses to $0.00 ($3,597.56 less $3,597.56) and $0.00 ($3,640.05 less $3,640.05), respectively.
Reconciles audited October 2026 6120 Payroll Tax Expenses to $7,286.94 ($8,111.75 gross less $824.81 October Form 8974 credit) and audited October 6110 Salaries & Wages to $45,555.90.

Proves cumulative July-October 2026 6120 Payroll Tax Expenses are conserved at $10,504.52 ($3,217.58 Jul + $0.00 Aug + $0.00 Sep + $7,286.94 Oct = $20,425.53 gross less $9,921.01 total Form 8974 FICA credits).

Explains that IRC §41(h) / Form 8974 R&D payroll-tax credits offset employer payroll tax in the payroll periods in which the qualified R&D wages and FICA liabilities were incurred rather than dumping 4 months of retroactive credits into October.
Verifies QBO BookCloseDate is unset (open across Jul-Oct 2026) and originalPeriodCorrectionAuthorization=true permits in-place prior-month reallocation without ever mutating QBO closing dates.
